gaps.sentence: He was praised for his ___ (BRAVE) during the fire.
gaps.explanation: 'His bravery' — quality noun; 'braveness' exists but is rare; 'bravery' is standard.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
The instructions were ___ (WRITE) in six languages.
gaps.explanation: Passive voice: were written — irregular participle of write.

gaps.sentence: The medicine may cause ___ (SLEEP), so avoid driving.
gaps.hint: noun: the state of wanting to sleep
gaps.explanation: 'Cause sleepiness' — the noun for the drowsy state.

gaps.sentence: The road was closed because of ___ (VISIBLE) conditions.
gaps.hint: noun phrase: how far you can see
gaps.explanation: 'Visibility' = the distance you can see; paired with 'poor'.
'Cause drowsiness' — the quality noun from drowsy.
